summary: Seven-phase plan (9h, 6 waves) for asserting Seriality and Interpolation in BimodalSemantics. Phase 1 stands up a same-host 52-example regression harness under this task's own baselines/. Phase 2 is a hard-time-boxed measurement gate for the task's preferred definitional-reachability alternative, with pre-stated go/no-go criteria and an explicit scope call: a favourable measurement is recorded and spawned as a follow-on task rather than expanding this one mid-flight, since it would demote nullity_identity/converse/forward_comp to derived theorems. Phases 3-4 are TDD RED/GREEN against the Skolemized encodings the research benchmarked (nested ForAll/Exists is forbidden by name, being a measured BM_TH_3/BM_TH_4 regression at M=2). Phases 5-6 run in parallel: core.py docstring correction plus stale three-axiom test naming, and the ARCHITECTURE.md '### Frame-Class Axioms' subsection with the duration-domain footnote. Phase 7 is the full 52-example regression gate with individual flip accounting.

artifacts.summary: Seven-phase implementation plan with dependency waves, per-phase verification tiers, and scope hypotheses.

decisions_made: Mandated the Skolemized encoding for both Seriality and Interpolation by name and forbade the nested ForAll/Exists form, since the research measured the latter as a BM_TH_3/BM_TH_4 regression at M=2.

Scope call on the definitional-reachability alternative: measure it in a hard-time-boxed Phase 2 (the task text demands the measurement be recorded), but do not implement it in this task even on a favourable result -- it changes what build_frame_constraints items 7-9 are, and belongs in a separate task. Flagged as a user scope decision on seeing Phase 2's numbers.

Ruled out z3.TransitiveClosure for the Phase 2 prototype on three independent grounds (no in-tree precedent, wrong shape for a duration-indexed relation, Z3-specific against z3_shim.py's cvc5 migration); the prototype uses the backend-neutral unrolled finite disjunction over the 2M-1 duration window instead.

Resolved the task's 'four ASSERTED axioms' table-row language: no reading yields four. Per Z3 constraint row it is 5 asserted / 2 free (the research report's own Section 4.1 arithmetic reaches 'four' only by omitting Seriality from its own Section 4.2 table); per paper axiom it is 2 asserted / 2 free. Phase 6 carries the 7-row constraint-level table with a note stating both counts.

Phase 1 adds a same-host pre-change reference run alongside the recorded 152 baseline, so Phase 7 diffs against both rather than against a recorded baseline alone whose host conditions cannot be reproduced.
BM_TH_1/BM_TH_2 are inconclusive-at-90s in the recorded baseline; Phase 7 must report an unchanged timeout there as 'no signal', never as evidence of no regression.
next_action_hint: Run /implement 153 to execute the plan, starting from Phase 1 (regression harness and pre-change reference run).
